name: Guildford Open 2017
information: Registration opens on Friday 28th July, 7pm BST. The steps for registration are as follows: * Register for the competition on the left. * Once confirmed on the waiting list, pay the fee on the [UKCA website.](http://www.ukca.org/competitions/upcoming-competitions/guildford-open-2017/registration) * Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration. This fee is non-refundable, as it represents a commitment to attending the competition. There is a competitor limit of 120.
